title: Team Plus Launches Remote AI Staffing Solutions For Global Tech Companies
description: New Delhi [India], August 19: AI, or artificial intelligence, is becoming a pivotal part of business operations. Companies around the globe are using AI for automation tasks, data analytics, customer service, and project design and development. It is growing rapidly and continuously; the demand for AI professionals is increasing too. However, hiring skilled professionals can be really challenging as there is a shortage of skilled candidates to fill the vacancies. The regular hiring process is slow and not very convenient for everyone.

title: Shares fall in Asia, with Kospi down 5.7%, while oil prices jump
description: Shares are sharply lower in Asia after Wall Street pulled further from its all-time high as artificial-intelligence stocks resumed their decline. South Korea's Kospi dropped 5.7% and Tokyo's Nikkei 225 sank 3.2%. Oil prices rose about 50 cents. On Tuesday, the S&P 500 fell 0.7% for a third straight loss. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped 0.2%, and the Nasdaq composite sank 1.3%. Nvidia, Micron Technology and Broadcom were some of the heaviest weights on the market on criticism that their prices shot too high in the frenzy around AI. Treasury yields held relatively steady.
